caption:
Allah and His angels do this. Will you?

Allah sends His blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ and His angels pray for him. Then He calls the believers to do the same. Fill this Friday with blessings on him.

Surah Al-Ahzaab 33:56

Send blessings on him now, then pass this on to a friend

#jumuah #salawat #durood #quranreels

Recitation: Ahmed Al-Ajmi
alt_text: Indeed, Allah sends His blessings upon the Prophet, and His angels pray for him. O you who believe, invoke Allah’s blessings upon him, and send him greetings of peace (Surah Al-Ahzaab 33:56)
